source.title: 126. Milosrđe Božje - Oganj vječni i Život vječni?

summary.title_hr: 126. Milosrđe Božje - Oganj vječni i Život vječni?
summary.abstract_hr: Epizoda je molitveno-propovjednička emisija kanala Ora et Labora iz Međugorja, snimljena na Dušni dan, 2. studenoga. Uključuje molitve zaštite, Krunicu Božjega milosrđa, Gospinu krunicu sa šestom deseticom za duše u čistilištu te tumačenje čitanja iz Izaije, Psalma, Poslanice Rimljanima i evanđelja o posljednjem sudu (Mt 25,31-46). Voditelj zahvaljuje za završeni 40-dnevni post protiv duhova nacionalizma i rata te poziva na nastavak posta po abecednom redu prezimena. U tumačenju govori o duhovnom 'pokrivaču' koji zastire narode, o bolnom 'obrezanju srca' pojedinca i naroda, o slobodnoj volji i o poduzetništvu. Uz to iznosi oštre stavove o ljevici, nacionalizmu, pobačaju i međureligijskim inicijativama. Zaključuje da na kraju postoje samo dvije stvarnosti, pakao i život vječni, poziva na djela uz molitvu i post te najavljuje promocije knjige 'Isus lider' i rad domoljubne inicijative Ora et Labora.
key_points: Voditelj tvrdi da je 40-dnevni post protiv duhova nacionalizma i rata, završen krajem listopada, donio plodove. Kao potvrdu navodi zadnju Gospinu poruku iz Međugorja od 25. listopada, koja poziva na jaču molitvu za mir, te pad s vlasti srpskog političara kojeg naziva ratnim huškačem (ime nije navedeno).
Poziva vjernike da nastave postiti po abecednom redu prezimena: ponedjeljkom A–Đ, utorkom E–K, srijedom L–P, četvrtkom R–Ž, a petkom svi. Preporučuje i post o kruhu i vodi srijedom i petkom.
Tumači Izaijin 'pokrivač koji zastire sve narode' kao duhovnu tamu, odnosno oblak smrti. Tvrdi da se ta tama razara molitvom i postom, a ne političkim idejama.

Ističe da Bog poštuje slobodnu volju svakog čovjeka. Molitva i post za člana obitelji plodonosni su ako se ta osoba sama opire grijehu, a ako je svjesno odabrala takav život, roditelji to trebaju prihvatiti i strpljivo moliti.
Obrezanje srca, odnosno unutarnje pročišćenje, opisuje kao bolan proces koji se događa postom. Kao osobni primjer navodi da je s 26 godina prestao igrati košarku kako bi se posvetio obitelji.

Tvrdi da se Europom širi povratak komunizma i duha socijalizma, pa kao protutežu ističe važnost obiteljskog poduzetništva, uz napomenu da je i Isus bio poduzetan tesar. Kritizira i nacionalizam i takozvane progresivce te smatra da se katolici trebaju ujediniti oko križa, a ne oko ideje hrvatstva.

Na temelju evanđelja o posljednjem sudu zaključuje da na kraju postoje samo pakao i život vječni. Poručuje da nije dovoljno samo moliti i postiti, nego treba činiti djela za druge i živjeti u strahu Božjem.
key_topics_en: prayer and chaplet of divine mercy
fasting and circumcision of the heart
the last judgment and eternal life
criticism of communism, the left, and nationalism
key_points_en: The host claims that the 40-day fast against the spirits of nationalism and war, completed at the end of October, bore fruit. As confirmation, he cites Our Lady's latest message from Međugorje of October 25, which calls for stronger prayer for peace, and the fall from power of a Serbian politician whom he calls a warmonger (the name is not stated).

He calls on the faithful to continue fasting according to the alphabetical order of surnames: on Mondays A–Đ, on Tuesdays E–K, on Wednesdays L–P, on Thursdays R–Ž, and on Fridays everyone. He also recommends fasting on bread and water on Wednesdays and Fridays.
He interprets Isaiah's 'veil that covers all nations' as spiritual darkness, that is, a cloud of death. He claims that this darkness is destroyed by prayer and fasting, and not by political ideas.

He emphasizes that God respects the free will of every human being. Prayer and fasting for a family member are fruitful if that person resists sin themselves, and if they have consciously chosen such a life, parents should accept that and pray patiently.

He describes the circumcision of the heart, that is, inner purification, as a painful process that occurs through fasting. As a personal example, he mentions that at age 26 he stopped playing basketball in order to dedicate himself to his family.

He claims that a return of communism and the spirit of socialism is spreading through Europe, so as a counterweight he highlights the importance of family entrepreneurship, noting that Jesus too was an enterprising carpenter. He also criticizes nationalism and so-called progressives, and believes that Catholics should unite around the cross, and not around the idea of Croathood.

Based on the Gospel on the Last Judgment, he concludes that in the end only hell and eternal life exist. He sends a message that it is not enough only to pray and fast, but that one must do deeds for others and live in the fear of God.
summary.title_en: 126. Divine Mercy - Eternal Fire and Eternal Life?
summary.abstract_en: The episode is a prayer and preaching broadcast of the Ora et Labora channel from Međugorje, recorded on All Souls' Day, November 2. It includes prayers of protection, the Chaplet of Divine Mercy, Our Lady's Rosary with a sixth decade for the souls in purgatory, and an interpretation of the readings from Isaiah, the Psalm, the Epistle to the Romans, and the Gospel on the Last Judgment (Mt 25:31-46). The host gives thanks for the completed 40-day fast against the spirits of nationalism and war, and calls for the continuation of fasting according to the alphabetical order of surnames. In the interpretation, he speaks about the spiritual 'veil' that covers the nations, about the painful 'circumcision of the heart' of the individual and the nation, about free will, and about entrepreneurship. In addition, he expresses sharp views on the left, nationalism, abortion, and interreligious initiatives. He concludes that in the end there are only two realities, hell and eternal life, calls for deeds alongside prayer and fasting, and announces promotions of the book 'Isus lider' and the work of the patriotic initiative Ora et Labora.
